items.label: Stable and Durable
items.value: The powder-coated steel frame is rust-resistant and heavy-duty, while the hand-woven rattan is tight-knit and weather-resistant. Each chair holds up to 250 lbs. Dimensions: 22.5"W x 21.5"D x 28.7"H

items.label: Exquisite Comfort Rocking Design
items.value: Our patio rocking chairs set are specifically designed to make the most of any outdoor space, these rocking chairs offer a gentle, relaxing motion that feels as good as it looks

items.label: Easy to Clean
items.value: Cushions come with removable black polyester covers for quick and easy cleaning. The tempered glass tabletop makes wiping up spills effortless

items.label: Modern and Simple Style
items.value: This patio furniture sets are suitable for any environment such as poolside, garden, yard, porch or balcony,etc. Lightweight materials let you easily rearrange whenever you want

items.label: Easy to Install
items.value: All hardware and tools are included for a hassle-free setup. Just follow the step-by-step instructions and you’re ready to relax

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 Coffee Table, 2 Rocking chair, 2 Seat Cushions
